title: Budgets are alerts
summary: A budget helps track spending and can notify you when a threshold is reached. An alert is not automatically a hard spending stop.
introduction: A budget helps track spending and can notify you when a threshold is reached. An alert is not automatically a hard spending stop. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A budget helps track spending and can notify you when a threshold is reached. An alert is not automatically a hard spending stop.

blocks.text: The arithmetic is 5 times 0.8. These are invented planning numbers, not an AWS price quote.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Calculate a 50 percent alert point for the same budget.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Read service costs and clean up authorised practice resources; an alert alone does not cap charges.
